zh: 週五（10/2）美股在疲弱的非農報告後上揚：標普 500 漲 0.73% 收 7,722.57，那斯達克綜合指數漲 1.12%，道瓊漲約 250 點（0.49%）收 51,176.46，羅素 2000 約漲 0.7%。壞消息變成好消息的原因是升息預期降溫，科技股領漲、那斯達克 100 創收盤新高。但一週算下來標普只漲 0.01%，基本上是原地踏步，今天的漲幅是在補週初的跌幅，不是新趨勢。
en: U.S. stocks rose Friday after a weak jobs report: the S&P 500 gained 0.73% to 7,722.57, the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.12%, the Dow added about 250 points (0.49%) to 51,176.46 and the Russell 2000 gained roughly 0.7%. Bad news became good news because rate-hike bets cooled, with tech leading and the Nasdaq 100 at a record. For the week, though, the S&P 500 was up just 0.01%, so today mostly repaired earlier losses rather than starting a new trend.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，週五約 +0.7%，一週僅 +0.01%
那斯達克 100 ETF，約 +1.1%，指數創新高
道瓊 ETF，約 +0.3% 至 0.5%，落後科技
羅素 2000 ETF，約 +0.9%，跟漲但幅度小於那指

zh: 個股面最刺眼的是硬碟股：日經亞洲報導東芝計畫投資約 3.8 億美元、在 2027 財年前把硬碟產能加倍，Seagate（STX）收跌約 10%、Western Digital（WDC）收跌約 10.1%，盤中 STX 一度跌近 15%。Seagate 今年以來已大漲約 190%，這類被供不應求推高的股票，一有供給增加的消息就是最先被賣的。另一頭，Teradyne（TER）宣布與東京威力科創合作，單日漲 8.0%、是 379 檔觀察名單中的第一名。
en: The sharpest single-stock move was in hard-drive names: Nikkei Asia reported Toshiba plans to spend about $380 million to double hard disk drive capacity by fiscal 2027, and Seagate (STX) closed down about 10% and Western Digital (WDC) down 10.1%, with STX off nearly 15% intraday. Seagate was up roughly 190% this year, and stocks lifted by shortages are the first to be sold on any hint of added supply. On the other side, Teradyne (TER) jumped 8.0% on a partnership with Tokyo Electron.

stocks.n: 硬碟大廠，收跌約 10%，年內漲幅約 190% 被一次吐回
硬碟與快閃記憶體，收跌約 10.1%
半導體測試設備，與東京威力科創合作後漲 8.0%

zh: 商品與地緣：G7 週五同意協調釋出 1 億桶石油與燃料儲備，分四個月釋出、前 20 天以柴油為主，由國際能源署統籌；西德州原油盤中跌 3.75% 到 89.39 美元，布蘭特跌到約 99.9 美元，原油週線下跌 1.53%。美國柴油價 9/22 創 6.52 美元高點，週五仍是 6.37 美元。同一天川普又向中東增派 9,000 名美軍，並稱若證實以色列班機劫持與伊朗有關，伊朗會被重擊，所以這次油價下跌是供給措施壓住風險溢價，不是風險消失。
en: Commodities and geopolitics: the G7 agreed Friday to coordinate the release of 100 million barrels of oil and fuel from reserves over four months, with much of the diesel in the first 20 days, coordinated by the IEA. WTI fell as much as 3.75% to $89.39 and Brent to about $99.9; crude fell 1.53% on the week. U.S. diesel hit a record $6.52 on Sept. 22 and was $6.37 Friday. Trump also sent 9,000 more troops to the Middle East, so the decline reflects supply measures capping the risk premium, not the risk disappearing.

stocks.n: 美國原油基金，週五約 -2%，反映 WTI 下跌
能源類股 ETF，約 -0.1%，跌幅遠小於原油
黃金 ETF，約 -0.9%，金價一週跌約 1.4%
Cheniere，液化天然氣出口商，盤中跌約 4.3%

zh: 盤勢結構：週五漲的是科技、非必需消費與原物料（XLK +1.3%、XLY +1.2%、XLB +1.0%），半導體 ETF（SMH）大漲 2.7%；醫療（XLV -0.3%）、金融（XLF -0.3%）與能源（XLE -0.1%）則小跌。有市場觀察指出，標普 500 逼近歷史高點時，約 75% 的成分股仍低於 50 日均線，也就是指數創高主要靠少數權值股撐。這種沒有寬度的新高過去較少見、現在越來越常見，意味著指數數字比多數持股的感受更漂亮。
en: Market structure: Friday's leaders were technology, consumer discretionary and materials (XLK +1.3%, XLY +1.2%, XLB +1.0%), and the semiconductor ETF (SMH) jumped 2.7%, while health care (XLV -0.3%), financials (XLF -0.3%) and energy (XLE -0.1%) slipped. One market observer noted that with the S&P 500 near a record, about 75% of its members sit below their 50-day averages, meaning the index is held up by a few heavyweights. Breadthless highs were once rare and are now common, so the index looks better than most portfolios feel.

stocks.n: 半導體 ETF，週五 +2.7%，領漲全場
科技類股 ETF，+1.3%
醫療類股 ETF，-0.3%，落後的一邊
金融類股 ETF，-0.3%

zh: 美光（MU）週三盤後公布 2026 財年第四季：營收 542.3 億美元（預期約 504.5 億）、調整後每股盈餘 33.42 美元（預期約 31.16 美元），調整後毛利率 87.0%，連續第六季創營收紀錄。下一季營收指引中位數 615 億美元、每股盈餘 38.15 美元，管理層說 2027 年絕大多數 HBM 供給已簽約、價格更高，供給吃緊會延續到 2027、2028 財年。但資本支出上調壓過數字本身，盤後股價只是小幅走低，市場在問「這麼高的毛利能撐多久」。
en: Micron (MU) reported fiscal Q4 after Wednesday's close: revenue $54.23 billion versus about $50.45 billion expected and adjusted EPS $33.42 versus about $31.16, with an adjusted gross margin of 87.0% and a sixth straight record revenue quarter. Guidance midpoints are $61.5 billion revenue and $38.15 EPS, and management said most 2027 HBM supply is already contracted at higher prices, with tightness lasting through fiscal 2027 and 2028. A higher capex forecast outweighed the numbers and shares eased after hours: the market is asking how long such margins can last.

stocks.n: 記憶體大廠，營收 542 億美元、毛利率 87%，盤後因資本支出上調小跌
HBM 的最大買家之一，週五創盤中新高 237.88 美元
快閃記憶體同業，盤中跟儲存股一起下跌約 3.4%

zh: Accenture（ACN）週四公布財報，每股盈餘 3.29 美元（預期 3.18）、營收 186.8 億美元（預期 180.3 億），股價當天大漲約 16%，盤中最高漲逾 22%。週五這個漲幅被吐回一部分，收盤跌約 5% 至 6%，約 199 美元。這是財報行情的典型兩段：第一天是意外，第二天是市場開始問「剛剛漲的有多少是補跌」。對 IT 服務同業來說，這份財報顯示企業的 AI 與顧問訂單沒有消失，但單日 20% 的波動本身就說明它之前被壓得很低。
en: Accenture (ACN) reported Thursday with EPS of $3.29 versus $3.18 expected and revenue of $18.68 billion versus $18.03 billion, and the stock jumped about 16% on the day, up more than 22% at one point. Friday gave back part of it, closing down roughly 5% to 6% near $199. That is the classic two-step of earnings rallies: day one is the surprise, day two is the market asking how much was just catch-up. For IT-services peers it shows AI and consulting demand has not vanished, though a 20% single-day move says the stock had been pushed very low.

stocks.n: IT 服務與顧問，財報日 +16%，隔天回吐約 5% 至 6%
同業對照，IT 服務族群的需求風向球

zh: Nike（NKE）週四盤後公布財報：每股盈餘優於預期，但營收低於預期、全年財測偏弱，並宣布更多裁員，中國需求疲弱與競爭加劇是主因。股價週五開盤前一度跌超過 7%，盤中約跌 5%，報價約 33 美元。這個價位讓人想到它只是一家運動品牌，不是科技股；當盈餘靠成本控制撐住、營收卻在下滑，市場通常不買單，而要等營收止跌才會重新定價。
en: Nike (NKE) reported Thursday after the close: EPS beat expectations, but revenue missed and the full-year outlook was weak, with more layoffs announced, blamed mainly on China weakness and rising competition. Shares fell more than 7% in premarket Friday and was down about 5% intraday near $33. When earnings are held up by cost cuts while revenue declines, the market usually refuses to pay, and it waits for revenue to stabilize before re-rating the stock.

stocks.n: 運動品牌，盈餘優於預期但營收與財測偏弱，週五盤中約 -5%
同業對照，看運動鞋服需求是否同步轉弱

zh: 9 月非農只增加 2.9 萬個職位，遠低於市場預期的約 8.4 萬，失業率從 4.1% 升到 4.2%，過去十二個月的平均增幅是 4.5 萬。8 月原本是 16.2 萬（三月以來最強），所以這是一個大幅反轉。Fifth Third 的首席經濟學家指出失業率上升有一部分是更多人進入勞動力市場，失業與就業不足的合計比率反而小降，把衝擊稍微緩和；他也說受 AI 影響大的產業就業在下降，製造 AI 的技術職位在增加。
en: September nonfarm payrolls rose only 29,000, far below the roughly 84,000 expected, and the unemployment rate rose from 4.1% to 4.2%; the 12-month average gain is 45,000. August had been 162,000, the strongest since March, so this is a sharp reversal. Fifth Third's chief economist noted part of the rise in unemployment reflects more people entering the labor force, while the combined unemployment and underemployment rate edged lower; he also said employment is falling in industries adopting AI aggressively and rising among technical workers who build it.

stocks.n: 非必需消費 ETF，週五 +1.2%，就業降溫沒有壓倒它
薪資處理龍頭，其民間就業報告下週一公布，是就業數據的第二個讀點

zh: 疲弱的就業數據讓 10/27 至 28 的聯準會會議升息機率，依 CME FedWatch 降到約 18%，維持現行 3.75% 至 4% 區間的機率約 81%。這一輪的討論不是降息、而是要不要再升，因為通膨與油價仍是首要擔心，Fifth Third 說下一次決策取決於 9 月 CPI、PPI 與油價。十年期殖利率週五回落到約 5.23%，但仍在 2002 年以來的高位附近；下週三（10/7）公布 9 月會議紀要，是下一個可以讀到官員語氣的時間點。
en: The weak jobs data cut the odds of a rate hike at the Oct. 27 to 28 FOMC meeting to about 18%, per CME FedWatch, with about an 81% chance of holding the 3.75% to 4% range. The debate is not about cuts but whether to hike again, because inflation and oil remain the main worry, and Fifth Third says the next decision depends on September CPI, PPI and fuel prices. The 10-year yield eased to about 5.23% Friday but is still near its highest since 2002; the September FOMC minutes next Wednesday (Oct. 7) are the next read on officials' tone.

stocks.n: 二十年期以上美債 ETF，殖利率仍在 2002 年以來高位附近
七到十年期美債 ETF，對應十年期殖利率 5.2% 左右
金融類股 ETF，利率路徑與升息預期直接影響銀行獲利

zh: 美國聯邦住房金融局（FHFA）計畫指示房利美與房地美，要求放款機構從兩家信用報告機構而不是三家調取資料，彭博報導。這等於替 FICO 評分在房貸市場長期的優勢引入競爭，Fair Isaac（FICO）盤前跌約 7.1%，收盤仍跌約 7.1%。政策風險對這類被視為「通行費」型的企業特別大：營收模式靠制度規定而存在，制度一改，估值倍數就先被重新計算。
en: The Federal Housing Finance Agency plans to direct Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to require lenders to pull credit data from two credit-reporting bureaus instead of three, Bloomberg reported. That introduces competition into FICO's long-standing advantage in the mortgage market, and Fair Isaac (FICO) fell about 7.1% premarket and closed down about 7.1%. Policy risk hits toll-road style businesses hardest: their revenue exists by rule, so when the rule changes the valuation multiple is recalculated first.

stocks.n: 信用評分龍頭，FHFA 引入競爭後約 -7.1%
信用報告機構，兩局制度的直接相關方
信用報告機構，同為三大局之一，受規則影響

zh: 半導體 ETF（SMH）大漲 2.7%，Nvidia（NVDA）盤中創歷史新高 237.88 美元、市值突破 5.7 兆美元；Allegro MicroSystems（ALGM）漲 8.5%、MACOM（MTSI）漲 7.9%、Teradyne 漲約 8%、Applied Optoelectronics（AAOI）漲 7.8%，都是 AI 資料中心鏈上的零組件與測試股。資金從週初的防禦股回頭追「硬體基建」，連類比晶片廠 ON Semiconductor 也因併購案漲 5% 以上。要留意的是，同一天儲存股大跌，代表這條鏈上並不是全部一起漲，而是只有被視為瓶頸的環節。
en: The semiconductor ETF (SMH) jumped 2.7% and Nvidia (NVDA) hit a record intraday $237.88, pushing its market value past $5.7 trillion; Allegro MicroSystems (ALGM) rose 8.5%, MACOM (MTSI) 7.9%, Teradyne about 8% and Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI) 7.8%, all parts and test names in the AI data center chain. Money moved back from early-week defensives into hardware infrastructure, and even analog chipmaker ON Semiconductor rose over 5% on a deal. Note that storage names fell sharply the same day, so the chain did not rise as one: only the links seen as bottlenecks did.

stocks.n: AI 晶片龍頭，創盤中新高 237.88 美元，市值逾 5.7 兆
類比與感測晶片，羅素 1000 第一名 +8.5%
高速光通訊與射頻晶片，+7.9%
光通訊元件，收約 115.66 美元、+7.8%

zh: SpaceX（SPCX）週五漲約 6% 至 7.6%、收約 159 美元，因為公司在不到 13 小時內完成三次發射：週四早上的 Crew-13 載人任務、下午的 Transporter-18 共乘任務（130 個酬載），以及晚間的獵鷹重型火箭國家偵察局 NROL-97 任務。連帶地，衛星影像公司 Planet Labs（PL）漲 7.6%。SpaceX 6/12 以 135 美元掛牌、6/16 最高到 225.64 美元，現在仍比高點低約三成，說明這個題材的情緒波動比基本面變動快得多。
en: SpaceX (SPCX) rose about 6% to 7.6% Friday to close near $159 after completing three launches in under 13 hours: Thursday morning's Crew-13 crewed mission, Thursday afternoon's Transporter-18 rideshare with 130 payloads, and Thursday night's Falcon Heavy NROL-97 mission for the National Reconnaissance Office. Satellite imagery company Planet Labs (PL) rose 7.6% alongside. SpaceX listed June 12 at $135 and peaked at $225.64 on June 16, so it remains about 30% below its high, showing that sentiment in this theme moves much faster than fundamentals.

stocks.n: SpaceX，週五約 +6% 至 7.6%，仍低於 6/16 高點 225.64 美元
衛星影像與資料公司，同步漲 7.6%

zh: Tesla（TSLA）公布第三季交車 486,532 輛，高於彭博共識的 463,000 輛，股價漲約 5.2%，但交車量仍比上季少、比去年同期少 2%。更有意思的是儲能：本季部署 13.7 吉瓦時，Megapack 進入 Nvidia 的 DSX Ready 計畫、成為 AI 資料中心基礎設施的一部分。同一天 Rivian（RIVN）跌約 6.6% 至 14.2 美元附近，沒有看到明確的單一原因，Bloom Energy（BE）與太陽能 ETF（TAN）則跟著清潔能源一起漲。
en: Tesla (TSLA) reported third-quarter deliveries of 486,532 versus a Bloomberg consensus of 463,000 and rose about 5.2%, though deliveries were still below the prior quarter and down 2% year over year. More interesting was storage: 13.7 GWh deployed, and the Megapack entered Nvidia's DSX Ready program as AI data center infrastructure. The same day Rivian (RIVN) fell about 6.6% to near $14.2 with no clear single cause, while Bloom Energy (BE) and the solar ETF (TAN) rose with clean energy.

stocks.n: Q3 交車 486,532 輛、超過預期，約 +5.2%；Roadster 發表延到 10/15
電動車新創，約 -6.6%，沒有明確催化
太陽能 ETF，+2.1%，跟清潔能源一起漲

zh: 羅素 2000 週五約漲 0.7%，收在 2,834 點附近，今年以來約 +14%，一週內大致持平。小型股今天的邏輯很直接：疲弱的就業報告讓升息預期降溫、殖利率回落，對負債多、靠短期融資的公司是減壓，區域銀行 ETF（KRE）是這輪最清楚的受益者。要留意的是，小型股對「經濟轉弱」並不免疫，今天的上漲是靠「利率壓力減輕」撐的，如果之後就業數據持續惡化，故事會轉成盈餘下修。
en: The Russell 2000 gained about 0.7% Friday to near 2,834, up roughly 14% this year and about flat on the week. The small-cap logic today was simple: the weak jobs report cooled hike expectations and pulled yields down, a relief for leveraged companies reliant on short-term funding, and the regional bank ETF (KRE) was the clearest beneficiary. But small caps are not immune to a weakening economy: today's gains rest on easing rate pressure, and if jobs data keep deteriorating the story turns to earnings cuts.

stocks.n: 標普小型 600 ETF，品質篩選較嚴的小型股對照
區域銀行 ETF，這輪曲線變化的主要受益者
羅素 2000 ETF（Vanguard 版），約 +0.7%

zh: First Citizens BancShares（FCNCA）盤前大漲 16.76%。原因是它在 9/4 完成接手 BMO 的 138 家分行（跨 11 個州、約 50 億美元存款與 6.5 億美元貸款），加上公允價值重新評估後帳面價值大幅上調。分行總數超過 600 家，進入中西部、大平原與西部市場。這類買分行的併購之所以有意思，是因為買的是便宜的存款，而不是貸款；風險則是存款能不能留住，因為新客戶換銀行是有成本的。
en: First Citizens BancShares (FCNCA) jumped 16.76% premarket after completing, on Sept. 4, the acquisition of 138 BMO branches across 11 states (about $5 billion in deposits and $650 million in loans), along with large fair-value markups. Its network now exceeds 600 branches and reaches the Midwest, Great Plains and West. Branch deals are interesting because what is bought is cheap deposits, not loans; the risk is whether deposits stay, since customers switching banks carries real friction.

stocks.n: 接手 BMO 138 家分行後，盤前 +16.76%
區域銀行 ETF，銀行股整體對曲線與殖利率敏感

zh: onsemi（ON）10/1 宣布把先前 6 月公布的全股票收購 Synaptics（SYNA）改為全現金、每股 123 美元，交易價值約 57 億美元（原約 70 億美元），起因是 Synaptics 收到第三方未經邀請的競爭提案。SYNA 週五漲約 13.8%、ON 漲 5% 至 6%。全現金對被收購方比較有確定性，不用被 ON 的股價波動影響；而交易價值下降，來自 ON 股價的變化，不是 onsemi 少付了錢。接下來看有沒有競爭者出更高價。
en: onsemi (ON) announced Oct. 1 it is revising its June all-stock deal for Synaptics (SYNA) to an all-cash $123 per share, valued at about $5.7 billion versus about $7 billion before, after Synaptics received an unsolicited competing proposal. SYNA rose about 13.8% Friday and ON gained 5% to 6%. All-cash gives the target certainty free of ON's share-price swings; the lower deal value reflects the change in ON's share price, not onsemi paying less in substance. The next question is whether a rival bids higher.

stocks.n: 人機介面與連網晶片，每股 123 美元現金收購，約 +13.8%
收購方，約 +5% 至 6%，宣布預期立即增益每股盈餘

zh: 小型股判讀知識：羅素 2000 的成分裡，區域銀行佔權重超過 20%，所以這個指數其實是「半個銀行指數」。這意味著它對殖利率曲線的形狀、存款成本與商用不動產貸款品質特別敏感，跟標普 500 的科技權重完全是兩套邏輯。看小型股時，與其只看指數漲跌，不如分開看銀行與非銀行：同一天指數漲 0.7%，可能是銀行漲 2% 加上其他公司持平，也可能是整體普漲，兩者含意不同。
en: A small-cap reading tip: regional banks make up more than 20% of the Russell 2000 by sector weight, so the index is effectively half a bank index. That makes it unusually sensitive to the shape of the yield curve, deposit costs and commercial real estate loan quality, a completely different logic from the S&P 500's tech weighting. When reading small caps, look at banks and non-banks separately rather than the headline: a 0.7% rise could be banks up 2% with everything else flat, or a broad advance, and the two mean different things.

en: Forgent Power Solutions (FPS) rose about 6% Friday after Bernstein initiated coverage of the electrical distribution equipment maker at Outperform with a $48 price target. A familiar small-cap pattern: for a company few people research, the first sell-side report can trigger a re-rating because information was scarce. Optical component maker Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI) rose 7.8% to about $115.66 the same day; both tie to AI data center power and networking demand.

en: Hudson Technologies (HDSN) reclaims, reprocesses and sells refrigerants, positioned on the recovery side of the HFC phase-down, with a market cap near $300 million and a sell-side consensus of only 'Hold'. Q2 revenue was $78.3 million (+8%) and reclaimed volume grew 18% for a second year, but EPS of $0.12 missed the $0.18 estimate on weaker refrigerant prices, freight and software rollout costs. The turn-signal is buying that has not stopped: about $2.08 million of insider purchases in three months, plus major holder Hartree Partners buying 760,000 shares for about $4.47 million at $5.68 to $5.97 (filed Sept. 28). en: Granite Ridge Resources (GRNT) is a non-operated oil and gas company holding well interests across basins, trading around $5 with a market cap near $600 million. Q2 net income was $30.0 million ($0.23 per share), adjusted EBITDAX $79.6 million, production 32,044 Boe/d (51% oil), and the quarterly dividend is $0.11, roughly an 8.7% annualized yield at about $5. The turn-signal is director Miller buying 10,000 shares at $5.03 on Sept. 11, the CFO buying 6,000 on Sept. 4, and director Perry buying 100,000 shares for about $549,000 in May; management says 2026 is the last year capex exceeds cash flow, targeting 40,000 Boe/d by year-end. Risks are lower oil (WTI back near $89) and debt-funded capex. A research lead, not investment advice.

zh: Cardinal Infrastructure Group（CDNL）8/11 下調全年調整後 EBITDA 利潤率預期（16% 至 18%，原本是高於 20%），單日重挫 36.2%、三天內從 60 美元跌到 34.66 美元。創辦人兼執行長 Spivey、財務長、營運長與四位董事隨後買進，近三個月內部人合計買了 214,597 股、約 828 萬美元，Spivey 8/14 一筆就買了 83,350 股（約 320 萬美元）。判讀提醒：這是一個教科書型的集體買進，但後面還有多家律所宣布調查是否違反證券法、公司增資擴大到 400 萬股，10/1 股價仍下跌 5.3% 到約 30 美元，所以內部人買進擋不住稀釋與訴訟，只代表他們認為業務價值更高。
en: Cardinal Infrastructure Group (CDNL) cut its full-year adjusted EBITDA margin outlook Aug. 11 (to 16% to 18% from above 20%) and fell 36.2% in a day, from $60 to $34.66 in three sessions. The founder and CEO Spivey, the CFO, the COO and four directors then bought; insiders purchased 214,597 shares worth about $8.28 million in three months, with Spivey alone buying 83,350 shares (about $3.2 million) on Aug. 14. A cautionary read: it is a textbook cluster buy, but several law firms have announced securities-law investigations, the share offering was upsized to 4 million shares, and the stock fell another 5.3% Oct. 1 to about $30, so insider buying cannot stop dilution or litigation; it only says they think the business is worth more.

zh: 怎麼讀內部人買進：篩選器通常把「30 天內三位以上內部人公開市場買進」定義為集體買進，因為小型股的資訊落差最大、買家又是用自己的錢。近 60 天的例子是 Hudson Technologies（HDSN，該篩選器口徑較寬、列出 9 位買家，另一個來源只算內部人約 208 萬美元）與 Granite Ridge（GRNT，6 位買家、約 500 萬美元）。但要分清楚：這是看「誰、什麼職位、多少錢」，執行長與財務長的買進比董事的象徵性買進重，單筆 5 萬美元的董事買進則只代表一個態度。
en: How to read insider buying: screeners usually define a cluster as three or more insiders buying on the open market within 30 days, because information asymmetry is largest in small caps and the buyers are using their own money. Recent 60-day examples are Hudson Technologies (HDSN, where one screener's broader count lists nine buyers while another counts only about $2.08 million from insiders) and Granite Ridge (GRNT, six buyers, about $5 million). Distinguish who, what role and how much: a CEO or CFO purchase weighs more than a token director buy, and a single $50,000 director purchase is mostly a gesture.

zh: Surgery Partners（SGRY）董事 DeLuca 9 月買進 11,250 股，金額不大，但值得放在脈絡裡看：Q2 營收 5.83 億美元、淨虧損縮到 119 萬美元（去年同期虧 3,674 萬美元），出售 Idaho Falls 資產後資產負債表改善。12 位分析師的共識是「買進」、平均目標價 18.82 美元，所以它並不是被忽視的股票，內部人小額買進比較像是確認方向，而不是發現被忽略的線索。這一張當作對照：同樣是內部人買進，被充分研究的公司與沒人看的公司，含意不一樣。
en: Surgery Partners (SGRY) director DeLuca bought 11,250 shares in September, a modest amount worth placing in context: Q2 revenue was $583 million, the net loss narrowed to $1.19 million (versus a $36.74 million loss a year earlier), and the balance sheet improved after the Idaho Falls divestiture. Twelve analysts have a consensus 'Buy' with an average $18.82 target, so it is not a neglected stock, and a small insider purchase confirms direction rather than uncovering something overlooked. Use this as a contrast: the same insider buying means different things in a well-researched company and an unwatched one.

zh: 前眾議院議長 Nancy Pelosi 的家戶（以丈夫 Paul Pelosi 的帳戶）申報了 Bloom Energy（BE）的四筆買進，交易發生在 7 月下旬，包含普通股與買權，申報金額區間合計約 300 萬至 1,200 萬美元（金額只有區間、沒有精確數字）。申報時股價約 185 至 192 美元，現在約 289 至 294 美元，漲了約 55% 至 60%；Bloom 是為 AI 資料中心供電的固態燃料電池公司，這個部位押注的主題是資料中心的電力需求，結構與該家戶先前的 Nvidia 選擇權部位相似。但這份申報是交易後約 45 天才公開，選擇權的履約價與到期日才是真正資訊量，而申報本身看不出原因，也看不出之後有沒有賣出。
en: Former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi's household (through husband Paul Pelosi's accounts) disclosed four Bloom Energy (BE) purchases made in late July, including common stock and call options, with disclosed value ranges totaling roughly $3 million to $12 million (ranges only, no exact figures). BE traded around $185 to $192 at the time and is now around $289 to $294, up about 55% to 60%; Bloom makes solid-oxide fuel cells powering AI data centers, so the position bets on data center power demand, with a structure similar to the household's earlier Nvidia options trade. But the filing arrived roughly 45 days after the trades, the options' strikes and expirations carry the real information, and the filing shows neither motive nor any later sales.

zh: 參議院 9/30 以 53 票對 47 票，未達 60 票門檻，沒有讓《禁止內線交易法》進入辯論，這個法案原本會禁止議員、配偶與受扶養子女買進新的個股；眾議院 7 月已以 232 比 198 通過自己的版本，卡住的原因是眾議院共和黨加進的選民身分證條款，與股票無關。意思是議員仍可以交易個股，只要事後申報。這是判讀政要持股申報的好提醒：以眾議員 Kevin Hern 9/25 的申報為例，涵蓋 8/27 至 9/15 的交易，主要是 Devon（DVN）與 Exxon（XOM）的部分賣出（各 10 萬至 25 萬美元區間），只有兩筆小額買進 Coca-Cola 與 Chubb（各 1,001 至 15,000 美元）；申報晚了數週、金額是區間、動機不明，所以不是買賣訊號。
en: The Senate voted 53 to 47 on Sept. 30, short of the 60 needed, and did not advance the Stop Insider Trading Act, which would have barred members, spouses and dependent children from buying new individual stocks; the House passed its version 232 to 198 in July, and the bill stalled over a voter ID clause House Republicans attached, unrelated to stocks. Members can therefore still trade individual stocks as long as they disclose afterward. It is a good reminder for reading filings: Rep. Kevin Hern's Sept. 25 report covers Aug. 27 to Sept. 15 and mostly shows partial sales of Devon (DVN) and Exxon (XOM) in the $100,001 to $250,000 range, with only two small buys of Coca-Cola and Chubb ($1,001 to $15,000 each). Filed weeks late, in ranges, with motives unknown, it is not a trading signal.

zh: 今天最值得記的是「壞消息變好消息」的條件：就業只增 2.9 萬、失業率升到 4.2%，股市卻大漲，因為市場當下擔心的是升息，不是衰退。這個邏輯成立的前提是殖利率回落（十年期仍在約 5.2%、接近 2002 年以來高位）；如果之後數據連續轉弱，市場的擔心會從「利率太高」轉成「盈餘下修」，到時候同一組數據的解讀會反過來。再加上標普約 75% 的成分股低於 50 日均線、只有少數權值股在撐，這一天的漲勢比看起來脆弱。
en: What is worth remembering today is the condition under which bad news becomes good news: payrolls rose only 29,000 and unemployment hit 4.2%, yet stocks rallied, because the market's current fear is a hike, not a recession. The logic holds only if yields fall back (the 10-year is still near 5.2%, close to its highest since 2002); if data keep weakening, the fear shifts from rates being too high to earnings cuts, and the same numbers will be read the other way. With about 75% of S&P 500 members below their 50-day averages and a few heavyweights doing the lifting, today's rally is more fragile than it looks.
